address: Blk C, #01-34, Jackson Square, 11 Lorong 3 Toa Payoh, 319579, Singapore
bio: This joint specialises in noodle soup with wontons and char siu – the springy noodles are shipped from Hong Kong; the lightly charred pork has layers of fat and lean meat. For extra texture and flavour, order shredded abalone on top....
